articles.title: TEZSPIRE® DEMONSTRATES POSITIVE PHASE 3 RESULTS IN EOSINOPHILIC ESOPHAGITIS ACROSS BOTH CO-PRIMARY AND ALL KEY SECONDARY ENDPOINTS
articles.summary: Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) and AstraZeneca today announced positive top-line results from the Phase 3 CROSSING trial of TEZSPIRE® (tezepelumab-ekko) in patients living with eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE). TEZSPIRE demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements across co-primary and key secondary endpoints at week 24 which were sustained through week 52. The co-primary endpoints were histologic remission and the frequency and severity of dysphagia (difficulty swallowing).
